name: KeePass
author: Ignace Helsen
description: Search the KeePass database from the bar and copy a password to the clipboard; unlocks once and re-locks after an idle timeout

barWidget.description: Search entries and copy passwords without opening the KeePass app

schema.label: Database file
schema.description: The .kdbx file to open. A leading ~ is expanded. The database is only ever read, and it is read in a helper process that forgets it again after the idle timeout.

schema.label: Key file
schema.description: Optional second factor, for databases protected by a key file as well as a master password. Leave empty when the database uses a password alone.

schema.label: Lock again after
schema.description: Seconds of inactivity before the helper drops the decrypted database and the master password is needed again. The timer restarts on every lookup, so a working session stays unlocked.

schema.label: Clear the clipboard after
schema.description: Seconds a copied password stays on the clipboard before it is scrubbed, and only if nothing else has copied over it since. 0 leaves it there, which is the answer only if something else on the machine already manages that.
